mermaid:
---
title: OAuth 2 Authorization Code Login with PKCE
---
sequenceDiagram
  autonumber
  participant B as Browser
  participant S as SPA
  participant A as Auth Server
  participant R as API
  B->>S: Click "Log in"
  activate S
  Note over S: Make code_verifier, code_challenge = SHA256(verifier), state
  S->>B: Redirect to /authorize (code_challenge, state)
  deactivate S
  B->>A: GET /authorize?response_type=code&code_challenge
  activate A
  A-->>B: Login and consent page
  B->>A: Submit credentials and consent
  A-->>B: 302 to redirect_uri?code&state
  deactivate A
  B->>S: Load callback with code and state
  activate S
  Note over S: Check state matches
  S->>A: POST /token (code, code_verifier)
  activate A
  Note over A: Check SHA256(verifier) equals code_challenge
  alt verifier valid
    A-->>S: Access token, ID token, refresh token
  else verifier invalid
    A-->>S: 400 invalid_grant
  end
  deactivate A
  S->>R: GET /me (Bearer access token)
  activate R
  R->>A: Fetch JWKS (cached)
  A-->>R: Signing keys
  Note over R: Validate signature, audience, expiry
  R-->>S: 200 user profile
  deactivate R
  S-->>B: Render signed-in view
  deactivate S
